messages:
Alex R.: Quick follow-up from the 3/14 postmortem — need to lock owners and closure dates for the infra-scaling incident. Proposed action items: runbook updates, autoscaler tweak, on-call alerts tuning. I'll create JIRA tickets; please claim ownership and ETA.

Maria C.: I can take the runbook updates. ETA: 3 business days. Please assign INF-4823 to me.

Sam T.: I'll own the autoscaler tuning. Need a staging canary window to validate before prod. Creating INF-4824 now. Plan to run canary 3/17.

Jess L.: I'll pick up alerts tuning + oncall page updates. Need a doc handoff from Maria for alert examples. INF-4825 created and assigned to me.

Alex R.: RACI proposal (draft):
- Runbook: R=Maria C., A=Alex R., C=Jess L., I=Eng SRE
- Autoscaler: R=Sam T., A=Alex R., C=Perf Eng, I=Platform
- Alerts/oncall page: R=Jess L., A=Alex R., C=Runbook author, I=Support
Please call out disagreements here.

ops-bot: INF-4823 created by maria.c (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-4823)
ops-bot: INF-4824 created by sam.t (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-4824)
ops-bot: INF-4825 created by jess.l (https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-4825)

Maria C.: Added a checklist to INF-4823: 
```
- draft runbook (this week)
- review w/ oncall (2 days)
- PR & merge
- schedule a dry-run in staging
```
I'll update the PR link in the ticket when ready.

Sam T.: Canary scheduled for 3/17 02:00 - 05:00 UTC. I'll post perf metrics to the thread and tag @perf-eng for review.

Jess L.: Quick question — does this overlap with the Feb caching incident? We had similar OOM signals in the trace. If yes, we should add a recurring review for this pattern.

Alex R.: Good catch. Let's add a recurring 'incident-pattern review' owned by Platform. I'll open INF-4826 for the monthly review and link it back to these tickets.

Maria C.: I can add a dashboard query for error/memory patterns and link it in INF-4823. That should help the monthly review.

Sam T.: Timeline check: Maria runbook done by 3/18, canary 3/17, alerts PR by 3/19. Is that everyone?

Alex R.: Yes. Closure criteria = (1) all INF-48xx tickets moved to Done, (2) runbook merged + dry-run completed, (3) alerts page live, (4) monthly review scheduled. Target closure: 2026-03-27.

Jess L.: I'll mark INF-4825 as In Progress and link the alert examples. Ping me if you want a walkthrough after the runbook PR.

Alex R.: Thanks all — I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and ticket links, and will follow up in two business days for status. @oncall please verify runbook steps during next shift.

Maria C.: noted, will post updates in tickets.

Sam T.: will post canary results 3/18.

Jess L.: done, will sync after PR review.
